title: Implement FT-001 session lifecycle services
verify: Login creates a new LocalSession and does not revive expired or revoked sessions.
Logout revokes only the current session and invalid/missing logout can be idempotent.
Session validity is fail-closed from session, Account, and FarmMembership status.
Internal activation primitive activates Account/FarmMembership and issues a session only after FT-003 validates invite credentials.
T3 closure includes /verify PASS, /red-verify semantic-pass, HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done, and ROLLBACK_RECOVERY_NOTE: present.
evidence_required: internal activation primitive evidence without public FT-003 route implementation
constraints: Default session TTL is 7 days from created_at.
FT-001 exposes only the internal credential/session primitive used by FT-003; it must not expose a public invite activation route.
Pending activation and invited membership cannot access normal Farm/Plant data.
Preserve verified FT-000 app factory, settings, database/session, migration, readiness, runtime-root, and redaction anchors; stop if implementation contradicts the brownfield baseline.
invariants: Missing, expired, revoked, malformed, or unknown session fails closed.
Disabled Account or disabled FarmMembership fails closed.
Secrets/auth material must not enter logs, timeline, manifests, Bus, UI Feed, screenshots, exports, or agent context.
verification_targets: Check changed code preserves verified FT-000 app/settings/database/session/redaction baseline or records a blocker.
purpose: Implement the FT-001 local session lifecycle and the internal activation handoff primitive needed by FT-003.
success_outcome: Local credentials and sessions can be issued, validated, revoked, and fail-closed against Account and FarmMembership status.
anti_goals: No hosted recovery or email delivery.

forbidden_scope: FT-003 public local invite activation route
stop_conditions: Session lifecycle cannot be proven fail-closed.
Implementation requires public FT-003 route ownership.
Raw auth material would enter persistence, logs, or evidence.
Implementation contradicts verified FT-000 app/settings/database/session/redaction baseline.
